nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $m$, the edge family of the complete $k$-uniform hypergraph on the vertex set $\{0, 1, \dots, m-1\}$ is the family of all $k$-element subsets of $\{0, 1, \dots, m-1\}$.
nodes.title: Edges of the complete uniform hypergraph

nodes.summary: It is not the case that $k \, (1 - \pi(K_{k+1}^{(k)}))$ tends to $\infty$ as $k \to \infty$, where $\pi(K_{k+1}^{(k)})$ is the Turán density of the complete $k$-uniform hypergraph $K_{k+1}^{(k)}$ on $k+1$ vertices.
nodes.title: De Caen's conjecture is false

nodes.summary: For a natural number $k$, let $\pi(K_{k+1}^{(k)})$ be the Turán density of the complete $k$-uniform hypergraph on $k+1$ vertices. De Caen's conjecture asserts that $k \, (1 - \pi(K_{k+1}^{(k)})) \to \infty$ as $k \to \infty$.
nodes.title: De Caen's conjecture on Turán densities of complete hypergraphs

nodes.summary: For a natural number $k$, the Turán density $\pi(K_{k+1}^{(k)})$ of the complete $k$-uniform hypergraph $K_{k+1}^{(k)}$ on $k+1$ vertices is the limit superior, as $n \to \infty$, of the Turán density ratios $\mathrm{ex}(n, K_{k+1}^{(k)}) / \binom{n}{k}$, where $\mathrm{ex}(n, K_{k+1}^{(k)})$ is the Turán number of $K_{k+1}^{(k)}$ and the ratio is taken to be $0$ when $\binom{n}{k} = 0$.
nodes.title: Turán density of the complete $k$-graph on $k+1$ vertices

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
